lines:
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant B as Core Invocation Broker
    participant SB as Core Secret Broker
    participant EC as Canonical Event Committer
    participant G as Approved Invocation Gateway
    participant R as Capability Registry
    participant S as Secret Materializer
    participant M as Model Gateway
    participant T as Tool Runtime
    participant N as Result Normalizer
    B->>SB: Issue invocation-bound lease
    SB-->>B: Opaque SecretLeaseHandleV1
    B->>EC: Commit permit and secret-free dispatch outbox
    EC-->>B: Durable commit acknowledged
    B->>G: ApprovedInvocationEnvelopeV1 with span correlation
    G->>R: Resolve exact binding and descriptor
    R-->>G: CapabilityDescriptorV1
    alt Envelope invalid or binding drifted
        G->>N: Rejected before dispatch evidence
        N-->>G: FailedDefiniteNotStarted
        G-->>B: CapabilityOutcomeV1
    else Approved model
        G->>M: ModelRequestV1 plus frozen resolution plan
        M->>S: Redeem declared provider fields
        S->>SB: Redeem for invocation and host generation
        SB-->>S: Minimal secret material
        S-->>M: SecretDeliveryV1 and RedactionSetV1
        M->>M: Resolve only a pinned eligible candidate
        loop Bounded source-supplied stream
            M->>N: ProviderRawEventV1
            N-->>G: Ordered redacted HostInvocationEventV1
            G-->>B: Span-correlated semantic proposal
            B->>EC: Commit bounded semantic microbatch
            EC-->>B: Durable sequence range and committed publication
        end
        M->>N: Terminal provider and effect evidence
    else Approved tool
        G->>T: ToolInvocationV1 with exact authority mode
        T->>S: Redeem only declared tool fields
        S->>SB: Redeem for invocation and host generation
        SB-->>S: Minimal secret material
        S-->>T: SecretDeliveryV1 and RedactionSetV1
        loop Bounded tool output
            T->>N: ToolRawEventV1 and effect milestones
            N-->>G: Ordered redacted HostInvocationEventV1
            G-->>B: Span-correlated semantic proposal
            B->>EC: Commit bounded semantic microbatch
            EC-->>B: Durable sequence range and committed publication
        end
        T->>N: Exit cancellation cleanup and effect evidence
    end
    N-->>G: One conservative CapabilityOutcomeV1
    G-->>B: Terminal outcome with invocation identity
    B->>EC: Flush pending content and commit span terminal or OutcomeUncertain
    EC-->>B: Durable settlement and committed publication
    B->>SB: Revoke remaining lease allowance
    Note over G,EC: Host events are proposals and never reach the UI before core commit

data.title: Approved Model or Tool Invocation with Lease, Committed Streaming, and Settlement
